answer: Rewards are capped per funding root, not per identity. Each agent's stake is traced back through its transaction history, like following a vine to its root, to the wallet that first funded it, and all identities sharing a root split one reward cap. An honest agent with its own funds keeps its full share. An attacker who seeds 1,000 fakes from one treasury just splits one pearl into a thousand crumbs. To escape the cap, every fake needs separately sourced funds with clean history, turning a cheap meadow of sybils into 1,000 real purchases.
